1 Auto-sync discovered physical screens (practice_manager, etc.) Disk scanner (`packages/primecare_ui`) screens Yes No

3 Sync selectors and cypress data-cy bindings Disk scanner (`test` & `lib`) screen_components (data_cy field) Yes No
4 Enforce Foreign Key connection directives explicitly Reconciler hook settings PRAGMA settings Yes No
5 Assign/modify roles or view permissions for discovered screen paths Access control reviews role_screen_permissions No Yes (Requires double-sign-off manual approvals)
